title: NATO phonetic alphabet, letters A through H
body: The NATO phonetic alphabet assigns a code word to each letter so spellings survive noisy radio channels. A is Alfa. B is Bravo. C is Charlie. D is Delta. E is Echo. F is Foxtrot. G is Golf. H is Hotel. The spellings Alfa and Juliett are deliberate: they prevent speakers of other languages from mispronouncing Alpha and Juliet.
